opening.argument: The title presents FORSAGE.io as the “best choice for starting in crypto,” while the speaker directly urges viewers to invest and get started. The offer is tied to recruitment-style earnings: he refers to “all the commissions” coming directly to him, thanks everyone in his team, and reports being paid within two or three weeks despite not signing anyone up. He further presents added income and a personal success account as support for joining. Those claims establish a recruitment commission opportunity, although the speaker’s credentials, the payment’s conditions, other participants’ outcomes, and any resulting loss are not independently established. The description’s warning to use trusted sources does not remove the promotional appeal.
